cues.en: If you get a copy of Remedy BG, it's literally just like a zip file. All you have to do is just grab an executable. And if you want to update it, you just download a new executable.
cues.zh: 如果你买了一份 Remedy BG，它实际上就是一个 zip 压缩包。你只需要拿到一个可执行文件就行。如果要更新它，直接下载一个新的可执行文件即可。

cues.en: Just one executable. And if that executable is anywhere on your machine, you double click it and it runs. And look at how fast that is. It's instant. You double click it and your debugger is running. Let me go ahead and set up a build here. It's exactly like you would expect in the session menu. There's just a thing where you can say what it is you want to debug. It also has a nice feature where you can just hit this plus and you can make as many of these configs as you want. Once you set these up, you can switch between them quickly. So if you want to run your debug, you just hit control shift one. If you want to run your release, hit control shift two. You have the ability to hit f five and your game runs or or, you know, whatever your program is that you're running like you see it here. You can do hover. You can do the same sort of stuff you would expect to do in any other debugger where you can kind of, like, pop things open quickly. What I tend to do is I just, you know, I type them into the watch window. The watch window works exactly as you would expect. However, unlike nowadays for things like Visual Studio, for example, you actually have extremely fast updating of the watch window. And this is pretty important. If I, for example, add ray origin single

cues.zh: 我松开手，我就知道监视窗口绝对是最新状态。我知道这话听起来有点荒谬，但如果你在 Visual Studio 里这么做，它……根本做不到这一点。它变得太慢、延迟太高了。我觉得他们基本上把这些更新操作延迟处理了。你根本做不出这种效果。所以我真的很喜欢 Remedy 的这一点。为什么？因为我在为自己争取时间。我可不想把时间浪费在等调试器上，因为我用调试器的唯一目的就是节省时间。如果调试器本身就很迟钝，

cues.en: So what Remedy BG does that's really awesome is it uses a digital audio workstation kind of a framework for it, where not only is there the ability to freeze or mute basically threads so that they won't do anything, there's also a solo option. So what you can do is just click solo and it will automatically freeze all of the threads that aren't that thread
cues.zh: Remedy BG 很厉害的一点是，它借鉴了数字音频工作站那套框架，不仅能冻结或静音线程让它们不再动作，还有个 solo 选项。你只要点 solo，它就会自动冻结除该线程之外的所有线程

cues.en: just as long as I keep that going so I can single step through what it's doing. Then as soon as I'm done, I just one click again and I'm back to the state that I was in before where all the threads are running. So it's a really, really great piece of human factors that, again, just makes it so that your debugging can be streamlined fast and find the bug, which is what you were trying to do rather than sitting around handling your debugger, which is not ever what you wanna do.
cues.zh: 只要保持这个状态，我就能单步调试它正在做的事。做完之后，再点一下，就回到之前所有线程都在运行的状态。这是非常非常出色的人因设计，让你的调试能 streamlined、快速找到 bug，这才是你真正想做的事，而不是耗在操作调试器上，那从来都不是你想要的。

cues.zh: 所以不像

cues.zh: 会急剧下降，

You will be shocked at how much faster it is. So obviously, not a lot to say about the other features here. There's, you know, a pretty straightforward stuff for, like, a register view. One of the nice things that Remedy lets you do is construct views even if registers if you want to. So in here, you can say, like, XMM zero, for example. And if I want to see this as something like four floats,
cues.zh: 在这里设置条件其实没那么糟糕。你几乎可以全速运行，同时还能加上条件断点。如果不把 Visual Studio 和 Remedy 中相同的条件断点拿出来给你看，真的很难向你直观展示这一点。但如果你是那种喜欢用条件断点的人，你肯定知道它们在 Visual Studio 之类的工具里有多慢，不妨去 Remedy BG 里设置同样的断点试试。你会惊叹它究竟快了多少。所以显然，这里的其他功能也没太多好说的。你知道的，寄存器视图这些东西都挺直观的。Remedy 提供的实用功能之一，就是允许你自定义视图，哪怕是针对寄存器也行。所以在这里，你可以输入像 XMM zero 这样的指令。如果我想把它当作四个浮点数来查看，

cues.en: and it formats it in a really nice way. Right? It's like, okay, there's that value of that as floats. And similarly, I can actually ask for anything that happens to be that type as a p s as well. So if, like, one of my values like max x y z, for example, I can ask for that to be viewed that way as well. So if I say, like, PS, it will show me one of my named variables in the same format. Obviously, you can always switch to viewing it as something else. These it isn't packed doubles, but if I ask it to be packed doubles, it would show it to me that way. Similarly, if I wanted four packed integers, I can get those unsigned. And these are just the same nomenclature that's used in the Intel Intrinsics guide. So if you can remember it for the Intrinsics, you also now know it for Remedy BG, which is also great. Okay. So a lot of times in game development, you will have things like four by three matrices, three by four matrices, four by four matrices, things like that. So if you do have a matrix like we have here, like our projection matrix, you can see that if you expand it, you will see basically the same thing you would see in any other debugger, right? Like you just got these drop downs here. And what you end up with is something that you can read. Like, it's not that bad. I can see all the values, but it's definitely not as convenient as it could be because it's kinda hard to keep track, especially when you kinda get these things. They don't line up when you have some that are, like, high precision, some that are low precision, and and so on. So Remedy BG has this nice modifier. You just put comma m t x, and that will automatically show you something as a four by four matrix. You can also say m t x like four x three or something if you want a different dimension matrix. So if you have something like a four by three matrix instead of a four by four matrix, you can still see it. This makes things a lot easier because now you can see the matrix looking the way that you would write it by hand if you were trying to write it in math form, which just makes it a lot easier to work with because now you can actually see what the heck is going on in your matrices,
cues.zh: 它会以非常棒的方式进行格式化。对吧？就像是，行吧，这就是转换成浮点数后的值。同样地，我实际上也可以请求将任何碰巧是该类型的数据显示为 p s 格式。因此，比方说我的某个变量叫 max x y z，我也可以要求用这种方式来查看它。所以如果我输入像 PS 这样的指令，它就会用相同的格式显示我命名的一个变量。显然，你随时可以切换成其他格式来查看。这些虽然不是打包双精度数，但如果我要求它显示为打包双精度数，它就会那样显示给我。同样地，如果我想要四个打包整数，我可以获取它们的无符号版本。这些命名规则和 Intel Intrinsics 指南里用的一模一样。所以如果你能在 Intrinsics 里记住它们，现在你也同样能在 Remedy BG 里使用它们，这也是很棒的一点。好了。所以在游戏开发中，很多时候你都会用到四乘三矩阵、三乘四矩阵、四乘四矩阵之类的东西。所以如果你真的有一个像我们这里这样的矩阵，比如我们的投影矩阵，你会发现如果展开它，基本上看到的和其他调试器里没什么两样，对吧？就像你这里只有这些下拉菜单。最后呈现出来的结果是你能读懂的。其实也还行，我能看到所有的值，但它绝对没有想象中那么方便，因为很难跟踪，尤其是当你遇到这种情况时。当有些数值精度高、有些精度低等等时，它们根本对不齐。所以 Remedy BG 有一个很好用的修饰符。你只需要加上逗号 m t x，它就会自动把数据以四乘四矩阵的形式展示出来。如果你想要不同维度的矩阵，你也可以输入类似 m t x 四乘三之类的指令。所以如果你用的是四乘三矩阵而不是四乘四矩阵，你照样能看得清清楚楚。这让事情变得容易多了，因为现在你可以用手写数学公式时的那种直观排版来查看矩阵，这让处理起来轻松了许多，因为你终于能看清你的矩阵里到底在搞什么鬼了，

In this case, we have a tokenizer and it's tokenized a comment in our asset source file. And you can see that it says that the string is 355

It's just a bunch of binary data that got loaded. And I now need to go look to see if that binary data comports with what I think that it should look like. cues.zh: 你真正想看到的东西。比如，我有这个 token.txt。我可以写，比如看 token.txt 里某个特定计数的数据。也就是 token text count。如果我展开它，得到的就和 Visual Studio 里预期的一样，全是单个字符编码。只要在前面加上 STR 这个词，就能神奇地把它变成一个很棒的内联小窗口，像完整的文本显示一样展示整个内容。对吧？而且它仍然有那个小放大镜，可以弹出窗口，就像 Visual Studio 里那样。但因为我其实根本不在乎那个，我通常就保持这样，这样我就能看到所有想看的东西，而不用离开我舒适的监视窗口。对我来说，这简直是彻底改变游戏规则的东西，因为我所有字符串都是这样工作的。我日常写代码从来不用以 null 结尾的字符串。所以单是这个功能，就让我在处理字符串密集的东西时调试字符串相关代码容易多了。太舒服了，因为现在我的监视窗口就是能用。我能看到所有字符串，不用操心去弹出那些破窗口才能看清发生了什么。不过，Remedy BG 还不止于此。如果你有类似这种情况：我们有一个后台线程正在加载资源数据，它有个 work order 在这里。你可以看到它是个结构体。我所做的是，我直接告诉线程，这里有个目标缓冲区，它就是一块盲内存。对吧？这只是个加载线程，它其实不知道自己加载的是什么。所以当我需要调试这种代码时，我需要能在完全不了解内容的情况下查看这个目标缓冲区。它并没有什么结构。对吧？它只是一堆被加载进来的二进制数据。而我现在需要去看看这些二进制数据是否符合我认为它应该有的样子。显然，Remedy BG 确实支持你会做的那种标准操作：我可以打开几个内存窗口，就是纯盲内存窗口，然后在里面填地址，这就是你通常会预期做的事。比如，如果我想查看这个特定位置的内存，我可以这么做，然后看到正常的内存视图，和你预期完全一样。然而，

cues.en: when you're working with code that does a lot of memory stuff, you would rather have the watch window show you a bunch of things right in line together that are different memory locations so that you can easily see memory moving back and forth and see when you're reading from one thing or writing to another. Remedy lets you do that really easily. You can type in a format specifier for memory. So for example, if I want to look at double words, for example, 32 bit values, the code for that is DD. And then I can just say whatever the size is that I want to look at. That will put an inline memory view right here that I can have in my memory window at all times. Don't actually have to create a separate memory window for it. I can just have them in the watch window. So if there were other things I want to do, I could just stack them up here. Furthermore, I can always pop this out into its own memory window. So if I do decide at any time that I want a memory window just displaying this particular location in this particular format, I can always just branch those off really quickly, close them really quickly, and paste together
cues.zh: 当你在处理涉及大量内存操作的代码时，你肯定希望监视窗口能把不同内存位置的一堆数据直接并排显示出来，这样你就能轻松观察内存来回搬移的过程，看清自己是什么时候在从某个地方读取数据，又是什么时候在向另一个地方写入。Remedy 能非常轻松地做到这一点。你可以为内存输入格式说明符。比如，如果我想查看双字，也就是 32 位的值，它的代码就是 DD。然后我只需要指定我想查看的大小即可。这就会在这里直接嵌入一个内存视图，我可以随时让它显示在我的监视窗口中。实际上完全不需要为此单独创建一个内存窗口。我可以直接把它们放在监视窗口里。所以，如果还有其他想做的事，我直接把它们堆叠在这里就行了。此外，我随时可以把它弹出到一个独立的内存窗口中。因此，如果我随时决定需要一个专门用来以特定格式显示这个特定位置的内存窗口，我随时可以非常快速地将它们分流出去、非常快速地将其关闭，并拼凑出

cues.en: whatever I actually want to see in terms of memory. So memory becomes as easy as a watch, which is a really big boon to people who actually need to work with these low level memory kinds of things from day to day. I can also ask for other formats. So for example, if I want word data instead, I can. I can get quad words as well. So again, you can just kind of, like, ask for how you want the memory formatted just like you would in normal memory window. But here you can do it in like a shorthand notation so it's quick to put it into the watch window.
cues.zh: 任何我真正想查看的内存内容。因此，内存查看变得和监视变量一样简单，对于那些每天都需要处理这种底层内存操作的人来说，这绝对是一个巨大的福音。我还可以请求其他格式。例如，如果我想要字数据，我也完全可以做到。我同样也可以获取四字数据。所以再说一次，你只需像在普通内存窗口中那样，指定你想要的内存格式即可。但在这里，你可以用简写符号来完成，这样就能很快速地把它放进监视窗口中。

cues.en: Let's suppose that I'm down in the code here and I'm looking at some stuff. I'm working on this thing. There's an enclosing kind of structure called a SIM region that has a bunch of information. It's kind of like a bundling structure that it it tells me the context. Like, it's got, like, where the origin is and all these sorts of things. And when I go into certain leaf functions, like, let's say I'm going into this draw ground cover function here, you can see that I'm not gonna be passing that in. So once I get into draw ground cover, you can see that I lose the ability to view that sim region. And so Remedy BG has a lot of tools for working with the scope that make it easy to solve this problem if you want to just save yourself time. So one way that this might work is there's a little lock icon that I can click on. When I click on the lock icon and then I step in here, it's just not going to update this sim region variable. So while I'm in here in draw ground cover, the sim region itself is going to stay the same value that it used to be. So it won't actually change to the fact that there isn't a sim region in this particular scope. That's a really easy way to do that, but that's not the only way you could do that. So for example, if we actually maybe weren't ever out here, like, let's suppose that my breakpoint hadn't been set on draw ground cover and my breakpoint was actually set here. So when I run to here, sim region never had a value to begin with. In fact, let's say I had never even typed it in and I type it in now, I type sim region, well, it's not going to find it. So instead of having to go hunt up the stack, like the way you would do this in traditional debugger is you go to call stack, you go up here and find sym region like that. Right? That's not very useful. In Remedy, it becomes more useful because I can quickly quick lock and then come back here. So that's one solution. But what if it was way up the stack there? In fact, we could imagine a situation where it was way up the stack. Let's say out here as game state. Right? So I wasn't even looking at sim region. I was maybe looking at game state. So in here, you know, I I type in game state.
cues.zh: 假设我就在这儿的代码里，正在看一些东西。我在处理这个东西。有一个叫 SIM region 的外围结构，包含一堆信息。它有点像一种打包结构，能告诉我上下文。比如，它有原点位置之类的信息。当我进入某些叶子函数时，比如说我进入这个 draw ground cover 函数，你可以看到我不会把那个传进去。所以一旦进入 draw ground cover，你看，我就失去了查看那个 sim region 的能力。而 Remedy BG 有很多处理作用域的工具，如果你想省时间，这些工具能轻松解决这个问题。一种方式是有一个小锁图标，我可以点击它。当我点击锁图标然后步入这里时，它就不会更新这个 sim region 变量了。所以当我在 draw ground cover 里时，sim region 本身会保持它原来的值。它不会因为当前作用域里没有 sim region 就变成没有。这是很简单的方法，但并不是唯一的方法。比如，如果我们其实可能从来没到过外面这里，假设我的断点没有设在 draw ground cover 上，而是设在这里。那么当我运行到这里时，sim region 从一开始就没有值。事实上，假设我从来没输入过它，现在输入它，我输入 sim region，好吧，它找不到。所以不用去调用栈上翻找——传统调试器里的做法是去调用栈，往上找，找到 sim region，对吧？那不太有用。在 Remedy 里这就更有用了，因为我可以快速锁定，然后回到这里。所以这是一种解决方案。但如果它在调用栈很上面呢？事实上，我们可以想象一种它在调用栈很上面的情况。比如说外面这里是 game state，对吧？所以我甚至没在看 sim region。我可能在看 game state。所以在这里，你知道，我输入 game state。

cues.en: And now I'm sitting here walking the stack to, like, find out where it actually is so I can lock it. If instead I just prefix it with a little scope, this is the scope specifying syntax in Remedy b g. It's just to enclose in brackets what you want to do. Star says find the first one of these by looking up the stack. Exactly what I just did clicking through call stack till I saw it, that's what Remedy is gonna do. And now I don't have to worry about which function I'm in. I can just step through. And as long as I'm underneath somebody who knew what the game state was, we're all good. If you are working on code that's a little more complicated in terms of how the call graph works, let's say you're in something where you've got a recursive function and you just want to know what the previous one was or what two up was, you can also in here put a specific number. One says go one up and see if it's there. Two says go two up, see if it's there. Three says go three up. And so we can look at different ones by putting different numbers in there. You can imagine something where you're looking at, you know, node or something and you wanna do something like this. Like, show me the whole stack of what node was each of the ways up. That is one way you can easily do it in Remedy, and it will work. Another thing you can do in Remedy BG lets you do some things in the debugger that normally you would think you would have to write an extension to a debugger to actually use in something like Visual Studio. Here is an example where I have a set of assets.
cues.zh: 现在我坐在这里沿着调用栈查找它实际在哪里，这样才能锁定它。如果我只是给它加上一个小作用域，这是 RemedyBG 中用于指定作用域的语法。它就是把你要执行的内容放在方括号里。星号表示通过查找调用栈来找到其中第一个匹配项。这正是我刚才做的事情：不断点击调用栈，直到看到它；Remedy 就会替你完成这个操作。这样一来，我就不用担心自己当前位于哪个函数中了。我只需要逐步执行即可。只要我位于某个知道游戏状态的调用者之下，一切就没问题。如果你处理的代码更复杂一些，调用图也更复杂，比如处在一个递归函数中，只想知道上一个调用，或者上面两层的调用，那么也可以在这里指定一个数字。1 表示向上查找一层，看看那里是否存在。2 表示向上查找两层，看看那里是否存在。3 表示向上查找三层。所以，我们可以通过填写不同的数字来查看不同的调用。你可以想象这样一种场景：你正在查看某个节点之类的东西，想要执行类似这样的操作。比如，显示这个节点在调用栈向上每一层分别是什么。这是你在 Remedy 中可以轻松实现的一种方式，而且确实可行。在 RemedyBG 中，你还可以在调试器里完成一些通常需要为调试器编写扩展，才能在 Visual Studio 之类的工具中使用的操作。这里有一个例子，我手头有一组资源。

cues.en: There is an asset holder basically that just has an array of assets. You can see here that I can look at the first one and of course there's an asset count in there as well. So if I just do assets, asset count, you can see that I get the standard view that I would normally get. And that view is fairly useless to me because there's just a ton of data in here. So honestly, if I'm not looking at a specific thing at any given time, there's really not a whole lot that I'm going to do with this particular way of viewing things that helps me at a glance. So one of the things that Remedy BG has recently added that's kind of amazing is you can now do tabular displays of your data, where if you have an array listing like this, you can actually tell it to make a columnar display with only specific things. For example, let's suppose in here that the thing that I mostly care about is the state of the asset and what type of asset it actually is. Maybe inside the type
cues.zh: 这里有个资源持有器，基本上就是持有一个资源数组。你可以看到，我能查看第一个，当然里面还有个资源数量。所以如果我直接执行 assets、asset count，就能看到平时会看到的标准视图。那个视图对我来说相当没用，因为里面数据太多了。老实说，如果我不是在某个时刻盯着某个具体东西看，用这种查看方式并不能让我一眼获得多少帮助。Remedy BG 最近加了一个挺厉害的功能：现在可以对数据做表格显示；如果你有像这样的数组列表，就可以让它只针对特定字段生成列式显示。比如，假设这里我最关心的是资源的状态，以及它实际是什么类型。也许在类型里面

cues.en: here, for example, and the state here. So one that's actually too deep and one that's only one deep. So I want to actually make it easier for me to read. I can do that by introducing
cues.zh: 比如这里的这个，还有这里的状态。所以一个是嵌套太深的，一个只有一层。我可以指定要列式显示，在这里加上花括号就能做到，然后用分号分隔列出我想要的内容。我用美元符号表示数组中当前正在显示的那个元素，接着可以用点语法访问它的某个属性。比如这里，假设用 .hha.type，就是访问 HHA 类型这个结构体；我还想要 .state。这就是我要它列出的两样东西。按回车后你会看到，它把监视窗口的这一部分变成了很漂亮的列式显示，在侧边像电子表格一样把所有值都列出来，方便查看。现在我还能更进一步，说我经常要用这个功能，也许我想让它……我要对这表格里的东西做一大堆调试，所以想让它读起来更容易。我可以这样做到：引入

cues.zh: 在实际的 struct 中。所以 Remedy 并不知道它们是什么，但我甚至可以在语法内部进行类型转换。因此，如果我想把它转换成我知道的 HIA 资产类型，这样更容易阅读，我就可以直接在语法中做到这一点，就像对任何其他监视值做的那样。状态也是如此。碰巧我知道那是一个资产状态值，它在实际的 struct 中并没有被标记出来。没问题。Remedy 允许我在执行列式列表时直接将其标记出来。所以同样地，我不必担心原始代码中是否包含该信息。我可以在事后直接添加这些信息。这实在是太神奇了。我现在拥有了一个资产表，它显示了系统中所有的资产及其状态。我还可以做一些其他的事情，例如，我可以添加一个表示索引的列。所以如果我愿意，在这里我实际上可以放一个表示资产实际索引的列。因此，如果我想知道我正在看的是哪个资产，知道它是表中的第 31 个资产，我也能获取到这个信息。这本身就已经极其强大了，但在 Remedy 中，你甚至可以将其再推进一步。正如我们在字符串等内容中所看到的，你总是可以把一个复杂的监视窗口值弹出到一个你可以停靠或拖拽的窗口中。因此，我可以把这个资产表变成一个永久的可停靠资产表，让我随时都能查看。然而，你会注意到的一点是，如果我跳出作用域，这个功能很快就会停止工作，因为现在该表达式实际上无法求值了。但正如我们所看到的，

cues.en: we actually have features in Remedy already that allow me to permanently look at things if I can say how you might find them in a scope. I can actually combine the power of the dynamic scoping stuff that's in Remedy with the power of the tablet display to get the best of both worlds. The asset structure is always stored off of the game state. If I say, hey, Remedy, go find in the enclosing scope a game state, whichever the first one is that you find, get the asset table off of that.
cues.zh: Remedy 里其实已经有功能，只要我能说明在作用域里怎么找到某个东西，就能长期查看它。所以现在我可以把这两样东西结合起来。我可以把 Remedy 里的动态作用域能力和平板显示的能力结合起来，兼得两者之长。资产结构总是挂在游戏状态上。如果我说，嘿 Remedy，去外围作用域里找一个游戏状态，找到的第一个就行，然后从它上面取资产表。
